desc: Our innovative Long Range Hybrid Target (LRHT) Rifle Bullet design provides competitive rifle shooters and long range accuracy enthusiasts a level of precision and consistency unmatched by all other Rifle Bullet manufacturers. They utilize our advanced and proprietary Meplat Reduction Technology (MRT) to produce a homogeneous and repeatable Rifle Bullet profile for the industry’s most consistent ballistic coefficients (BC). This means tighter groups and more hits on target.
